A '''hydroventilator''' was a piece of medical equipment. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jakarro]] delivered a number of hydroventilators as part of a shipment to [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].
